# Bettina A. Deynes Named One of the World’s Top 100 HR Leaders


Nov 24, 2026


Share


Great workplaces start with leaders who put people first, and Carnival Corporation’s Global Chief Human Resources Officer Bettina A. Deynes has built her career on that belief. Now, Human Resources Director (HRD) – a global human resources publication – has recognized her as one of the most influential HR leaders in the world.


HRD’s Global Top 100 HR Leaders and Executives list honors the top 100 HR professionals who have shown exceptional dedication to their organizations and teams over the past year, navigating rapid change, safeguarding employee well-being and guiding their executives through an evolving business landscape.


“I’m honored to be recognized alongside so many impressive HR leaders,” said Bettina. “This recognition really belongs to our incredible HR team and the 160,000 team members across our company who bring our culture to life every day. I’m proud to be part of an organization that invests in its people, and I’m grateful to support our team members as they grow their careers with us.”


The recognition builds on a track record of industry honors, including being named one of the National Women’s Conference Top 100 Women in Business in 2022, and follows her appointment to the Society for Human Resource Management Executive Council earlier this year.


Under her leadership, Carnival Corporation aims to be a leading employer of choice within the travel and leisure industry, where team members can build long-term careers shipboard and shoreside. That means offering unique pathways from entry-level positions to specialized roles, investing in programs that support team members’ well-being, and creating a positive workplace where every individual is treated with dignity and respect, and has the opportunity to thrive.


View the full list of the Global Top 100 HR Leaders and Executives from HRD[here](https://www.hcamag.com/au/best-in-hr/top-hr-executives-and-leaders-in-the-world-global-100-2026/598369) .
